items.title: 22.2 Alcohols aur phenols ki tezaabiyat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 22.2 with Quick Check 22.2 answered, printed pages 87-88 (PDF 90-91).

blocks.text: Alcohols ki dissociation (paani mein toot kar ions banna) bohat kam hoti hai. Yani paani mein ghulne par alcohol molecules zyada nahi toot'te. Equilibrium (tawazun) baen taraf rehta hai, yani RO⁻(aq) aur H⁺(aq) ions ke muqable mein alcohol molecules kahin zyada hote hain.

Paani jab dissociate hota hai to us ka equilibrium bhi baen taraf rehta hai, lekin alcohols ke muqable mein H⁺ ions zyada bante hain. Alcohol ke solution mein [H⁺(aq)] paani se kam hoti hai, is liye alcohols paani se kamzor acids hain.

Alcohols ke paani se kam acidic hone ki wajah un ke alkyl groups hain. Alkyl groups electron dene wale (electron donating) groups hain. Aise groups covalent bond mein electrons ko dhakelte hain; is ko positive inductive effect kehte hain. Alcohol molecule se ek proton (H⁺) nikalne par alkoxide ion banta hai, aur alkyl group is ion ko kamzor (destabilize) karta hai: alkoxide ion ka oxygen electron dene wale alkyl group se jura hai, is liye O atom par electron density aur barh jati hai. Is wajah se alkoxide ion H⁺ ko dobara le kar phir se alcohol ban jane ki taraf zyada mael hota hai.

blocks.alt: Khuli banawat wala ethanol (aq) ethoxide ion (aq) + H+ (aq) ke saath equilibrium mein. Ethoxide ion mein C-C aur C-O- bonds par teer ke nishan O- ki taraf. Do peele dabbe: 'position of the equilibrium lies to left' (equilibrium teeron ki taraf ishara) aur 'alkyl group donates electron density towards O- which is more likely to accept H+ again to form CH3CH2OH' (H+ ki taraf ishara). Labels: ethanol, ethoxide ion, hydrogen ion.
blocks.caption: Ethanol ka toot'na (dissociation): ethanol, ethoxide ion aur hydrogen ion (kitab ke PDF safha 90 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Ethoxide ion mein bonds par bane teer ke nishan (>) batate hain ke alkyl group electrons ko O⁻ ki taraf dhakelta hai (+I effect). Is se O⁻ par manfi charge aur ghana ho jata hai, woh H⁺ ko wapas kheench kar ethanol bana leta hai, is liye equilibrium baen taraf rehta hai. Kitab ke peele dabbe mein 'to from' chhapa hai; sahi 'to form' hai.

Phenol mein bhi alcohol wala (-OH) group hai, phir bhi yeh halka sa acidic hai. Is ki wajah yeh hai ke oxygen ka ek lone pair aromatic ring mein phail jata hai (delocalisation). Yeh delocalisation phenoxide ion ko mazboot (stable) banati hai; phenoxide ion phenol ka conjugate base hai.

Aisa is liye hota hai ke oxygen ka ek lone pair ring ke delocalised π system se overlap karta hai. Is delocalisation ki wajah se oxygen atom par charge density kam ho jati hai. Is liye H⁺ ions phenoxide ion ki taraf zor se nahi khinchte aur dobara phenol molecule banane ka imkan kam hota hai. Matlab phenol proton kho kar acid banne ki taraf zyada mael hai, proton le kar base banne ki taraf nahi.

blocks.alt: Phenol (aq) phenoxide ion (aq), yani O- wala benzene ring, + H+ (aq) ke saath equilibrium mein. Labels: phenol, phenoxide ion.
blocks.caption: Phenol ka toot'na: phenol aur phenoxide ion (kitab ke PDF safha 91 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Phenoxide ion: chhe surmayi carbon atoms ka ring, paanch chhote H atoms aur aik laal O atom. Carbon ring ke oopar aur neeche do neele chhalle phaila hua pi nizam (extended pi system) hain jo O tak pohanchte hain; O ke paas manfi charge ka nishan. O par do neele lobes '2 x sp2 - orbitals' hain.
blocks.caption: Oxygen ka manfi charge aromatic ring par phail (delocalise ho) jata hai, is liye ion mustahkam hai (kitab ke PDF safha 91 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Phenoxide ion mein O ka ek lone pair p orbital mein hai jo ring ke π system se mil jata hai; neele chhalle dikhate hain ke π system ring se O tak phaila hua hai. Is tarah manfi charge sirf O par nahi rehta, poore ring par phail jata hai aur ion stable hota hai. O ke baqi do lone pairs do sp² orbitals (neele lobes) mein hain jo ring ki satah (plane) mein hain.
Acidity (tezabiyat) ki tarteeb yeh hai: phenol > paani > ethanol.

blocks.prompt: Methanol aur ethanol ki acidic taqat ka muqabla karein.
blocks.explanation: Methanol thora zyada acidic hai: ethanol ka ethyl group methyl group se zyada electron density oxygen ki taraf dhakelta hai, is liye ethoxide ion methoxide ion se kam stable hai.

blocks.prompt: Electron delocalisation dikha kar samjhayein ke phenoxide ion (PhO⁻) ethoxide ion (C₂H₅O⁻) se zyada stable kyun hai.
blocks.explanation: Phenoxide mein manfi oxygen ka lone pair ring ke π system se overlap karta hai, is liye charge oxygen aur ring par phail jata hai. Ethoxide mein charge sirf oxygen par rehta hai aur ethyl group us par mazeed electron density dhakelta hai.

blocks.prompt: Alkali metals taqatwar acids se react kar ke hydrogen gas dete hain. Sodium ka ek tukra do beakers mein dala jata hai, ek mein ethanol aur doosre mein phenol. (a) Kis beaker mein hydrogen gas pehle aur tezi se niklegi? (b) Agar sodium dalne se pehle phenolphthalein indicator maujood ho to kaun sa solution pehle pink hoga?
blocks.explanation: (a) Phenol wale beaker mein, kyunke phenol ethanol se zyada taqatwar acid hai. (b) Ethanol wala: is mein banne wala sodium ethoxide taqatwar base hai aur phenolphthalein ko pink kar deta hai, jab ke sodium phenoxide kamzor base hai aur bacha hua phenol solution ko halka acidic rakhta hai.

items: Alcohols paani se kamzor acids hain: alkyl group alkoxide ion ko kamzor karta hai.
Phenol halka acidic hai: phenoxide ion mein charge ring par phail kar ion ko stable karta hai.
